text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-ALERT: P99 latency spike detected on serving-cluster/eu-west-1 at 8012345678. p95=420ms -> 1.2s, p99=1.1s -> 3.2s. Streaming stalls and tail packets reported. Affected model: redwood/decoder-v2-8k, node gpu-3a2 shows correctable ECC rate increase. Paging: oncall@eng-sre alerted.

maria.sre: i'm on it, pulling graphs now. can someone grab ECC counters and recent kernel logs?

alex.infra: looking at hw telemetry — gpu-3a2: temp spike ~92C for last 6m, fans at 100% but ECC correctables jumped from 0->~430 in 10m. not a hard failure yet but flakiness matches streaming stalls.

maria.sre: thanks. Grafana shortlink: https://graf.redwood/graf/abc123/p99?from=now-30m  — p99 tail aligns with spikes on gpu-3a2.

diego.runtime: runtime traces show KV cache misses spike and backpressure in the streaming path. some requests hit fallback and saw ~2s stall before retry. suspect intermittent ECC causing micro-pauses in kernel/driver.

maria.sre: we should live-mitigate: 1) cordon + drain gpu-3a2 from serving pool 2) scale up fallback pool (dedicated small-V100 pool) 3) enable router fallback to model-quantized variant to reduce per-token time.

alex.infra: agree. starting drain. kube drain command:

```
# drain node before maintenance
kubectl cordon node/gpu-3a2
kubectl drain node/gpu-3a2 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

alex.infra: also bumping capacity: `infra-scale --pool streaming-fallback --replicas +4 --region eu-west-1` (doing gradual to avoid cold-start surge).

maria.sre: diego, can you flip routing for active sessions to allow in-flight failover? we want minimal 5xx for clients.

diego.runtime: doing a sticky redirect: `router set-fallback --cluster streaming-fallback --grace 30s --preserve-sessions` — applying now.

kate.csm: customer impact note — ticket INC-2026-1234 opened. affected tenants: acme-inc (high), beta-partners (medium). csm draft for status page: "Investigating elevated streaming latency impacting a subset of customers in EU; mitigation underway, no data loss expected. Engineers are evacuating a flaky accelerator node; updates every 15m." ok to post?

maria.sre: +1. post ASAP. include workaround: retrying requests should succeed; temporary higher latency expected.

alex.infra: drain completed, pods evicted. node gpu-3a2 marked unschedulable. tail of dmesg shows repeated: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): Correctable ECC error detected` entries. log snippet: 

```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: RmInitAdapter failed!
[ 12346.012345] kernel: Correctable ECC error on GPU 0: serr=0x00000010
[ 12346.012367] kernel: GPU reset attempted
```

alex.infra: placing node into quarantine and raising a hardware ticket. vendor RMA may be required if repeats.

maria.sre: p99 back down to ~480ms after routing/fallback and scale-up. p95 ~200ms. monitoring: https://graf.redwood/graf/abc123/p99?from=now-10m

ops-rotation: taking handoff — i'm next oncall starting in 5m, will continue monitoring. can you drop a succinct runbook pointer and open an incident review?

maria.sre: runbook pinned: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/gpu-flake-evacuate. created incident review ticket: IR-2026-998, assigned to eng-runtime + infra.

diego.runtime: note to postmortem: check KV cache eviction thresholds during failover; our routing grace window caused a few duplicate in-flight attempts (minor increase in token cost).

kate.csm: posted status update on status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-1234 — customers notified, SL acknowledged.

maria.sre: summary for log: cause: intermittent correctable ECC errors + thermal spike on gpu-3a2 -> micro-pauses -> streaming tail p99 surge. mitigations: cordon/drain node, scale fallback pool + routing fallback to quantized model. impact: elevated p99 for ~12m for subset of EU tenants, no data loss, estimated cost bump due to retries. next: hardware RMA, follow-up RCA in IR-2026-998.

ops-rotation: i'll stay on until metrics stable for 30m and then close the paging. if anything else pops up ping me @ops-rotation. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (8012345700), p99 restored to acceptable SLO range (p99 < 600ms). incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev2, timeline recorded under IR-2026-998.

maria.sre: thanks team. postmortem owner assigned to diego.runtime. I'll file the immediate blameless notes.

kate.csm: CSMs notified customers on acme-inc and beta-partners, copy of logs attached to ticket.

alex.infra: hardware ticket raised with vendor: HDT-77823. putting node under quarantine label `quarantine:ecc-flake`.

maria.sre: closing thread for live mitigation. follow-up actions are in IR-2026-998 and hardware ticket HDT-77823.
